sec.title: Methods
sec.p: We targeted the CFTR locus in Homo sapiens (hg38) using Cas9. The guide RNA sequence was ATGGCGCTCTGGGCCTGTTC. The PAM motif was NGG. Electroporation delivered RNP into INT-407 cells (RRID:CVCL_1903). A non-targeting sgRNA was included. Editing was measured by ICE (n = 4 biological replicates). Off-target analysis used in silico off-target prediction with CRISPOR. Culture used DMEM at 37 °C.
